name: padi.test.chat.room
title: Chat room (TEST)
comment: Development/test profile (padi.test.* namespace). Room-model user messaging: members write one message at a time ADDRESSED into their own connection; the room hub merges every connection's posts into one rolling transcript and broadcasts it to all members. Interleaving, attribution and window size are deliberately hub/app-level semantics per the CNS/CP multi-connection rule. Both structured values are percent-encoded (URI-encoded) JSON so they travel safely inside the quoted wire-command format.

properties.name: feed
properties.description: Rolling transcript: percent-encoded JSON array of {id,from,name,text,ts}, newest last; hub-written, broadcast to every member

properties.name: post
properties.description: One message: percent-encoded JSON {id,name,text,ts}; member-written ADDRESSED into that member's own connection (id must be uniq

properties.name: ts
properties.description: Sample timestamp, UTC ISO 8601; applies to all values in the same update

name: skycentrics.oadr3.event.price
title: Price-based OpenADR 3.0 Profile
comment:
The OADR Controller will send a price signal for demand response to any consumers who want to receive such signals. 
The consumer will tell the device(s) that it controls to take an action in response to that signal. 
The consumer will then report the status of their devices back to the OADR Controller.
The OADR Controller can then compile and send this data as an "OADR Report" back to the VTN it is connected to.
CHECK ABOVE DESCRIPTION

properties.name: price
properties.description: A float indicating the price of energy

properties.name: unit
properties.description: The price unit. If omitted, assumed to be $/kWh

properties.name: operatingState
properties.description: The operating state of a resource under control of a VEN

properties.name: status
properties.description: Freeform string describing the status of the device

properties.name: oadrReportType
properties.description: string of format {'type': x, 'value': y, 'unit': z} for any report type listed in the OADR spec

name: skycentrics.oadr3.event.simple
title: Simple OpenADR 3.0 Profile
comment:
The OADR Controller will send a simple level signal for demand response to any consumers who want to receive such signals. 
The consumer will tell the device(s) that it controls to take an action in response to that signal. 
The consumer will then report the status of their devices back to the OADR Controller.
The OADR Controller can then compile and send this data as an "OADR Report" back to the VTN it is connected to.

properties.name: simpleLevel
properties.description: An indication of the level of a basic demand response signal. Payload value is an integer of 0, 1, 2, or 3. Note: An example map

properties.name: reportReq
properties.description: The report types that are requested

properties.name: operatingLevel
properties.description: Simple level that a VEN resource is operating at. Payload value is an integer 0, 1, 2, 3 corresponding to values in SIMPLE event

properties.name: status
properties.description: Freeform string describing the status of the device

properties.name: reports
properties.description: String for any report type requested by the provider. Formatted as [{'type': x, 'value': y, 'unit': z}, {...}]
